message.content:
**Paris Get‑Away Guide (7‑Day Itinerary)**  
*(Assumes you’re flying into Charles de Gaulle Airport – CDG – and staying in the 7th arrondissement, close to the Eiffel Tower and the Seine.)*

---

### Day 1 – Arrival & Orientation  
| Time | Activity | Notes |
|------|----------|-------|
| **Morning** | Arrive at CDG → take the RER B to Saint‑Germain‑en‑Laye → walk to your hotel | 30‑min train ride; free walking tour of the 7th arr. |
| **Afternoon** | Check‑in & lunch at **Café Constant** (famous for classic French bistro fare) | Try the steak frites or duck confit. |
| **Evening** | Stroll along the Seine, cross the Pont Alexandre III, and enjoy the sunset over the Eiffel Tower | Sunset light show starts at 20:00 on weekends. |

> **Tip:** Grab a *Paris Pass* for free metro rides and skip‑the‑line access to major attractions.

---

### Day 2 – Classic Landmarks  
| Time | Activity | Notes |
|------|----------|-------|
| **Morning** | Visit the Louvre (early opening 9:00) | Book tickets online; focus on the Mona Lisa, Venus de Milo, and the Egyptian Antiquities. |
| **Lunch** | Picnic in the Tuileries Garden | Pick up baguette, cheese, and wine from a nearby market. |
| **Afternoon** | Walk to the Musée d’Orsay | See Impressionist masterpieces; free entry on the first Sunday of each month. |
| **Evening** | Dinner at **Le Coupe Chou** (romantic, old‑world charm) | Reserve a table in advance. |

---

### Day 3 – Montmartre & Artistic Vibes  
| Time | Activity | Notes |
|------|----------|-------|
| **Morning** | Explore Montmartre: Sacré‑Coeur, Place du Tertre, and the artists’ square | Take the funicular or climb the stairs for panoramic views. |
| **Lunch** | **La Maison Rose** – classic French brasserie | Try the croque-monsieur. |
| **Afternoon** | Visit the Salvador Dalí Museum or the Espace Dalí | Great for surreal art lovers. |
| **Evening** | Cabaret show at **Moulin Rouge** | Book a dinner‑and‑show package for a full experience. |

---

### Day 4 – Day Trip to Versailles  
| Time | Activity | Notes |
|------|----------|-------|
| **Morning** | Take the RER C to Versailles Château | Arrive early to avoid crowds. |
| **Tour** | Guided tour of the palace, Hall of Mirrors, and the Gardens | Consider a bike rental to explore the gardens. |
| **Lunch** | **La Petite Venise** inside the palace grounds | Offers a view of the fountains. |
| **Afternoon** | Return to Paris; relax at the **Jardin du Luxembourg** | Great spot for people‑watching. |
| **Evening** | Light dinner at **Le Petit Cler** (market street) | Sample local cheeses and pastries. |

---

### Day 5 – Modern & Contemporary  
| Time | Activity | Notes |
|------|----------|-------|
| **Morning** | Visit the Centre Pompidou | Focus on modern art and the rooftop terrace. |
| **Lunch** | **Café du Centre** (inside Pompidou) | Quick bites and great coffee. |
| **Afternoon** | Explore the Marais district: Picasso Museum, Carnavalet Museum, and vintage shops | Walk through the historic streets. |
| **Evening** | Dinner at **L’As du Fallafel** (for a casual bite) | Try the famous falafel sandwich. |

---

### Day 6 – Culinary Immersion  
| Time | Activity | Notes |
|------|----------|-------|
| **Morning** | Cooking class at **Le Cordon Bleu** or a local culinary school | Learn to make croissants or macarons. |
| **Lunch** | Enjoy your creations | Pair with a glass of French wine. |
| **Afternoon** | Visit the **Marché des Enfants Rouges** (oldest covered market) | Sample fresh produce and international cuisine. |
| **Evening** | Sunset cruise on the Seine (Bateaux Mouches) | Book a dinner cruise for a romantic evening. |

---

### Day 7 – Relaxation & Departure  
| Time | Activity | Notes |
|------|----------|-------|
| **Morning** | Brunch at **Café de Flore** (iconic café) | Try the croissant and café au lait. |
| **Late Morning** | Last‑minute shopping on Rue Saint‑Honoré | Look for luxury boutiques and designer stores. |
| **Afternoon** | Pack & check‑out | Leave luggage at the hotel concierge if you have a late flight. |
| **Evening** | Depart from CDG | Use the RER B or a taxi; allow extra time for security. |

---

## Practical Tips

| Category | Recommendation |
|----------|----------------|
| **Transportation** | Purchase a *Paris Visite* pass for unlimited metro, bus, and RER within zones 1–3. |
| **Currency** | Euros (€). Credit cards accepted everywhere; carry some cash for small cafés. |
| **Language** | Basic French phrases help; most locals speak English in tourist areas. |
| **Safety** | Keep an eye on your belongings in crowded places; use a money belt. |
| **Weather** | Pack layers; Paris weather can be unpredictable. |
| **Dining** | Reservations recommended for popular restaurants; try *table d’hôte* menus for value. |

---

Enjoy your Paris adventure! If you’d like more details on any day, or need help booking tickets and reservations, just let me know.
